correctness.rationale: For fixed monadic vocabulary k>=2, the type multiplicity vector of U consists of t=2^k entries n/t and that of B of two entries n/2. Jaakkola–Kuusisto–Vilander Theorems 1 and 8 give 3m_(ell-1)-3 <= C(M) <= min(3m_ell+c_tau,6m_(ell-1)+c_tau) with c_tau=15k2^k. Plugging the vectors gives 3n/t+O_k(1) versus 3n/2+O_k(1). Since for fixed k the leading terms are positive, the ratio tends (3/2)/(3/2^k)=2^(k-1); Shannon entropies of uniform supports of size 2^k and 2 are k and 1. Independently checked coefficients and ratios at k=2,3,6,10. The result is NOT a uniform joint asymptotic with growing k.
